summary: Resume upload auth fix and review/confirmation step testing complete. All features working correctly: resume upload with auth token, review dialog with extracted data sections, Apply to Profile and Discard buttons, skills normalization, work history extraction, and select dropdowns.
passed_tests: POST /api/resume/parse/upload endpoint accepts file upload with auth token and returns parsed_profile
Resume upload without auth returns 401 (correct behavior)
Invalid file types (.exe) are rejected with 400
Oversized files (>10MB) are rejected with 400
POST /api/resume/parse/text endpoint works with auth
GET /api/resume/parses endpoint returns parse history
Resume upload button works for authenticated seeker without 'not authenticated' error
After upload+parse, review dialog appears showing extracted data sections
Review dialog shows Name extracted from resume
Review dialog shows Specialty (fixed [object Object] display bug)
Review dialog shows Work History count and detail with facility names, dates, specialties
Review dialog shows Skills count and badge chips
Review dialog shows Certifications
Review dialog shows Licenses
Review dialog shows Bio/Summary
Clicking 'Discard' closes dialog without changing profile
Clicking 'Apply to Profile' merges parsed data into profile state and shows success toast
Skills from resume are normalized (objects with {name, confidence} become plain strings)
Work history entries are appended to existing work history
Existing select dropdowns (Specialty, Availability, Shift) still work without errors
critical_code_review_comments: Auth fix correct: removed explicit Content-Type header from axios FormData upload - axios auto-detects multipart/form-data and sets correct boundary
Fixed specialty display bug in review dialog: specialties.map(s => typeof s === 'string' ? s : s?.name || '') to handle object format from AI parser
AI parser (resume_parser.py) uses GPT-4.1 via emergentintegrations - returns structured data with employment_groups, skills, certifications, licenses
Skills normalization in applyResumeData() correctly handles both string and {name, confidence} object formats
Review dialog uses data-testid attributes for testing: resume-review-content, resume-review-apply, resume-review-cancel
seed_data_creation: Test resume files uploaded during testing (stored in vault_documents collection)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resume upload auth fix verified working. The key fix was removing explicit Content-Type header from axios FormData upload - this was preventing the Authorization header from being included. Review dialog shows all extracted sections correctly after specialty display fix. MOCKED APIs: SendGrid, Twilio SMS, Nursys API.

mocked_apis.SendGrid: Email notifications mocked - logged to notification_logs collection
mocked_apis.Twilio SMS: DISABLED - send_sms logs and returns False immediately

resume_upload_auth_fix.issue: Old code set explicit Content-Type: multipart/form-data header which prevented axios from including Authorization bearer token
resume_upload_auth_fix.fix: Removed explicit Content-Type header - axios auto-detects multipart/form-data from FormData and sets correct boundary

resume_review_dialog.work_history_detail: Shows facility names, dates, specialties for each position

apply_to_profile.behavior: Merges parsed data into profile state, closes dialog, shows success toast
apply_to_profile.skills_normalization: Objects with {name, confidence} become plain strings
apply_to_profile.work_history_append: New entries appended to existing work history
